description: Source code for NVMe controller command implementations, including functions for identifying controllers/namespaces, creating/deleting I/O queues, and setting/getting features.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_identify_controller
methods.description: Sends an identify controller command to the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_identify_namespace
methods.description: Sends an identify namespace command to the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_create_io_cq
methods.description: Creates an I/O completion queue on the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_create_io_sq
methods.description: Creates an I/O submission queue on the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_delete_io_cq
methods.description: Deletes an I/O completion queue from the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_delete_io_sq
methods.description: Deletes an I/O submission queue from the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_set_feature
methods.description: Sets a feature on the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_get_feature
methods.description: Retrieves a feature from the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_ctrlr_cmd_set_num_queues
methods.description: Configures the number of queues on the NVMe controller.
